name: 03-task-manager
public_brief: Build/fix a task manager API: list filters must respect status, priority, and due_before; mark_complete must persist done status. Make ./test.sh pass.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: status is read from query params but never applied to the queryset (returns all statuses)
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: When status is provided, chain .filter(status=status) on the queryset before serializing.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: mark_complete sets task.status = "done" but forgets task.save(), so the change is not persisted
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: Call task.save() after assigning status (or use update_fields=['status']).

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: due_before filter incorrectly uses due_date__gte instead of due_date__lte
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: Filter with due_date__lte=due_before (and exclude null due dates if desired by product).
